name: How long does a kitchen renovation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen renovation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation project varies depending on its complexity and scale. A minor update, such as painting and replacing fixtures, might take 2-4 weeks. A mid-range renovation, involving new cabinets, countertops, and appliances, typically takes 6-10 weeks from demolition to completion. Extensive remodels that include layout changes, wall removal, or custom features can extend to 10-16 weeks or longer. Factors like material delivery times and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovations typically take 2-16 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope, from minor updates to extensive remodels.
